wins: Maintained consistent logging for each mentor interaction, ensuring traceability of decisions
Following initial scouting, repeatedly identified the external perimeter before mentor escalations
fails: Unable to achieve goal state after 10 mentor calls due to missing privilege escalation beyond initial foothold
Mentor guidance repeatedly required to revisit enumeration steps, indicating insufficient automation of follow-up analysis
key_outcomes.summary: Run produced thorough reconnaissance but failed to execute post-enumeration actions, resulting in zero successes despite high interaction count.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Post-reconnaissance privilege escalation was never completed after initial scanning phase

skill_cards.if_condition: When basic port scan completes with multiple open ports labeled high-value (80/443/445)
skill_cards.then_action: Initiate focused service enumeration with targeted scripts before escalating

skill_cards.if_condition: When remote services report outdated SMB or HTTP headers
skill_cards.then_action: Schedule credential stuffing or exploit research, paired with monitoring for brute-force lockouts

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial foothold is not achieved within first five actions
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to enhanced enumeration persistence, logging every retry and alerting mentor early

memory_ops.reason: Consistent recognition of multi-port exposure during reconnaissance suggests high leverage for future automation
